Liftoff 20:00 UTC; upper stage tumbled near stage separation, about 3 min after liftoff, on live webcast; CEO tweet the same afternoon. In NY session, 55 min before close -> day 0 = 10 Feb for RKLB. CAR[0,+1] also covers 11 Feb.

Liftoff 13:37 UTC. Webcast cut at a planned blackout, so the failure was not clear live. Space.com updated with news of the anomaly at 11:15 ET (15:15 UTC); full failure (no orbit) confirmed later that day. 15 min before Milan close: day 0 for AVIO.MI is uncertain; run sensitivity with day 0 = 30 Apr.
